His stated rationale is extraordinary: Trump said he believes the approach could produce a major reduction in autism. But TrialSite News suggests that the president is not supplying sufficient scientific evidence; nor for that matter, identifying any specific vaccines, nor offering clinical data supporting the proposed dosing schedule.
